about-heading: A curated approach to real estate
about-body: Through an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship and architectural integrity, Araf has established itself as a premier developer. We don't just build properties; we curate living experiences that stand as testaments to modern Saudi ambition and enduring quality.
about-text-1: We are Araf Real Estate Company, a national company specialized in real estate development. We place quality and innovation at the heart of every project we execute.
about-text-2: Since our establishment more than 6 years ago, we have charted our path with confidence toward leadership in providing urban solutions that keep pace with the aspirations of individuals and investors, contributing to building modern and sustainable communities.
vision-text: To be among the leading real estate development companies in the Kingdom, relied upon to deliver high-quality projects, smart designs, and an inspiring environment for living, working, and investing.
mission-text: To contribute to developing the Kingdom's urban landscape through qualitative projects that reflect the spirit of urban development, meet residents' needs, and achieve long-term economic and social value.
communities-body: Explore our portfolio of distinctive developments across the Eastern Province.
why-1-desc: Years of fieldwork across all development stages ensures unparalleled execution.
why-2-desc: Backed by an elite network of engineers, contractors, and designers.
why-3-desc: We follow market-driven strategies, rejecting imitation for authentic value.
why-4-desc: Full compliance with the Saudi Building Code and strict quality oversight.
why-5-desc: Strategically positioned developments ensuring lifestyle and investment value.
why-6-desc: Competitive, value-driven pricing structures for long-term equity growth.
journey-heading: Who we are & what we build
journey-body: Since our inception, Araf Real Estate has grown into a leading developer in the Eastern Province. By combining architectural excellence with strategic foresight, we create spaces that elevate the standard of living.
vision-body: "To lead the real estate market in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, leaving a clear imprint that reflects excellence, quality, and structural integrity."
mission-body: To innovate and deliver sophisticated real estate products that combine intelligent engineering with superior build quality. We aim to enrich lives and secure long-term value for our clients through unwavering standards and strategic growth.
footer-tagline: Where vision meets structure. Premium real estate development across Saudi Arabia.

proj-1-desc: Redefining luxury living in Dammam with breathtaking architecture and premium amenities.
proj-detail-text-1: Araf 1 is a landmark residential development designed for those who appreciate the finer things in life. Situated in a prime location in Dammam, this project seamlessly blends modern architectural aesthetics with functional living spaces.
proj-detail-text-2: Every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide residents with an unparalleled standard of living. From the grand entrance lobby to the state-of-the-art facilities, Araf 1 stands as a testament to our commitment to quality and innovation in real estate development.
brochure-desc: Download the complete presentation to explore floor plans and specifications.
manifesto-text: We do not just build structures. We engineer enduring legacies in the Saudi landscape, blending absolute precision with uncompromising luxury.
anatomy-material-desc: Every development is predicated on uncompromising material selection. From locally sourced Riyadh stone to imported Italian statuario, our supply chain ensures that surface aesthetics perfectly match structural longevity.
anatomy-spatial-desc: Volume is the ultimate luxury. Our layouts are engineered to maximize natural light refraction, ensuring every square meter serves a psychological and functional purpose.
